about.title: I care about the details that make software feel simple.
about.lead: I work across the whole product: the database, the API behind it, and the interface people use every day. Owning each layer keeps the product consistent and easier to change.
about.body: Most of my work is with companies and founders who need someone to turn their requirements into a finished, dependable product. I write clean, reusable code, and I pay close attention to performance and search visibility.
